page.overview:
Who is Noah Gocek?

Noah Gocek is the Next-Generation Clutch Aid Racer. He replaced Dino Draftsky as the Clutch Aid Racer.

While Lightning McQueen was training, Noah wanted to join Team Clutch Aid for a new Clutch Aid racer. So, he was sponsored. He was working hard on his speed. Luckily, he survived the Next-Gen Crash, but he was involved in the wreck. He finished in 24th place.
